provincial.name: Income Support
provincial.who: Age 18+, NL resident, application, eligible per financial assessment.
provincial.what: Basic monthly (excl shelter/fuel/special needs): single $561; couple $1,122; single parent $729; couple w/ children $1,122. Rent/mortgage up to $522 single alone, $299 with roommate, $598 couple. Fuel supplement $71 Island/$132 Labrador; $150 cost-of-living allowance coastal Labrador. Non-basic: municipal taxes, eye exams/glasses, employment childcare, burial. Extended drug card 12 months after leaving.
provincial.apply: Applying for Income Support page (gov.nl.ca/sswb/income-support/application/); signed complete application with documents. Email SSWBInfo@gov.nl.ca.
provincial.notes: Dept now named Social Supports and Well-Being (SSWB); old /cssd/ URLs 404 or redirect. Disability-specific income support not described on page.

provincial.name: Newfoundland and Labrador Disability Benefit (NLDB)
provincial.who: Ages 18-64, qualify for federal Disability Tax Credit, file tax return, valid DTC certificate, live in NL.
provincial.what: Up to $400/month ($4,800/yr). Full benefit income below $29,402; partial between $29,402 and $42,404 (individual or couple with one DTC); couples both DTC partial up to $55,404.
provincial.apply: No application required (page says so).
provincial.notes: Start date not stated on page. Related Provincial RDSP contribution ($1,200/yr, ages 18-49, DTC + RDSP, income below $42,404) is NOT yet implemented; no start date.

provincial.name: Health Related Services (Income Support: vision, dental, hearing devices, diet)
provincial.who: Primarily Income Support recipients; others may qualify after completing and being assessed on an Income Support application.
provincial.what: Vision: $100 toward eye exam (12 mo children/36 mo adults); glasses up to $290 single vision/$350 bifocal. Dental: children universal to 12, 13-17 if family on IS or Access Plan; adult IS recipients exam, x-rays, fillings/extractions every 3 yrs, dentures every 8 yrs. Hearing/Deaf devices one-time: visual smoke detector up to $250, Alertmaster $155, TTY $422. Special diet allowance up to $60/month.
provincial.apply: No separate application; apply for Income Support. Special diet line 1-877-729-7888.
provincial.notes: Medical transportation no longer under IS (see MTAP).

provincial.name: NL Child Benefit (NLCB)
provincial.who: Families with children under 18, net family income below $38,193 (full under $20,397).
provincial.apply: Paid via CRA with federal benefits; file taxes. Page gives no separate application.
provincial.notes: Child benefit, not disability-specific.

provincial.name: Prenatal-Early Childhood Nutrition Supplement
provincial.who: Pregnant or child under five (as summarized on NLCB page; details page not fetched).
provincial.what: $150/month (per NLCB page).
provincial.apply: See nutritionsupplement page.
provincial.notes: Only seen via NLCB page summary.

provincial.name: NL Prescription Drug Program: Foundation, 65Plus, Access, Assurance, Select Needs plans
provincial.who: Foundation: income support recipients etc (automatic). 65Plus: 65+ receiving OAS and GIS (automatic). Access: net income <= $42,870 families w/ children, $30,009 couples, $27,151 singles. Assurance: drug costs above 5% of net income (<$40k), 7.5% ($40-75k), 10% ($75-150k), reassessed every 6 months. Select Needs: cystic fibrosis/growth hormone deficiency.
provincial.what: Foundation/65Plus full coverage of eligible drugs; Access/Assurance co-payments apply.
provincial.apply: Application form: gov.nl.ca/hcs/prescription/how-do-i-apply/ ; 1-888-859-3535; healthinfo@gov.nl.ca.
provincial.notes: Select Needs is disease-specific: exclude from app. Access thresholds also seen in search results; fetch confirmed.

provincial.name: Special Assistance Program (medical equipment and supplies)
provincial.who: Live in community (not long-term care), need supplies/equipment for daily living, meet financial criteria in Income Based Financial Assessment Policy Manual.
provincial.what: Dressings, catheters, incontinence supplies, oxygen, orthotics (braces, burn garments), wheelchairs, walkers, commodes.
provincial.apply: Contact NL Health Services; page links to How to Apply (not fetched).
provincial.notes: Financial thresholds not captured.

provincial.name: Provincial Home Support Program
provincial.who: Functional and financial assessment by regional health authority for subsidy; seniors and adults/children with disabilities.
provincial.what: Non-professional personal care, behavioural support, household management, respite; subsidized up to a ceiling.
provincial.apply: Referral through NL Health Services (any person incl. self). Contacts: Eastern 709-752-4835; Central 1-833-210-8491; Western 709-695-6263; Labrador-Grenfell 1-833-284-4751.
provincial.notes: Older source (2009 release, search only) said singles income <= $13,000 / couples <= $21,000 pay no contribution; likely dated.

provincial.name: Paid Family Caregiving Option (home support)
provincial.who: Client of Adult Home Support Program with long-term need; pass clinical and financial assessment; caregiver relative (not spouse).
provincial.what: Paid family caregiver: personal care up to 4 hr/day seniors, 5 hr/day adults with disabilities; homemaking limits; respite by invoice.
provincial.apply: Contact regional health authority (numbers above), assessment and funding agreement.
provincial.notes: Page based on 2015 release; confirm current.

provincial.name: Special Child Welfare Allowance Program (SCWAP)
provincial.who: Family with child under 18 with physical or intellectual disability living at home; financial needs test.
provincial.what: Monthly financial help toward disability-related services; amount by needs test.
provincial.apply: Contact NL Health Services in your area.
provincial.notes: Amount not stated.

provincial.name: Direct Home Services Program incl. intensive ABA (autism)
provincial.who: Infants/preschoolers with or at risk of significant developmental delay; ABA: autism diagnosis, up to Grade 3 (per page).
provincial.what: Free home-based early intervention; ABA home training.
provincial.apply: Referral by family or provider to regional health authority.
provincial.notes: 2019 Autism Action Plan release said ABA to expand to age 21; unconfirmed.

provincial.name: Community Behavioural Services Program

provincial.what: Voluntary in-home/community behavioural support, reassessed every 6 months.
provincial.apply: Referral by family, provider, or adult individual.

provincial.name: Residential options for adults with disabilities (Co-op Apartment, Alt Family Care, Board and Lodging Supplement, ILA, Shared Living)

provincial.name: NL Housing: Home Modification Program (HMP)
provincial.who: Homeowners needing accessibility changes, income <= $51,500 ($65,000 Labrador), not NLHC clients.
provincial.what: Forgivable loan up to $15,000 (forgiven after 5 years). Ramps, wider doors, roll-in showers, grab bars, etc.
provincial.apply: Online via regional office or printed form; OT letter needed for major work only (changed Fall 2026).

provincial.name: NL Housing: Provincial Home Repair Program (PHRP)
provincial.who: Household income below $42,500 ($65,000 Labrador), own and lived in home 5+ yrs, not NLHC client.
provincial.what: Forgivable loan up to $10,000 ($13,000 Labrador); lifetime max $30,000.
provincial.apply: Online via regional office or printed form.
provincial.notes: Replaced HESP repairs.

provincial.name: NL Housing: Rental Housing Program (social housing)
provincial.who: Low income households incl. people with disabilities; limits not stated.

provincial.apply: Online or PDF application to regional office (Avalon 709-724-3197 etc.).
provincial.notes: Accessible units not mentioned.

provincial.apply: See NLHC; not confirmed.
provincial.notes: Seen only in search results. Apr 2026 release: +$4M/yr (~500 households).

provincial.what: Seniors' Benefit max $1,882 (from July 2026). NLIS max $520 (2025 yr) plus $231 for each person claiming DTC.
